entities.name: Service-level-AA container
entities.description: An information element included by the network during UUAA procedure for UE supporting UAS services, or when valid successful UUAA result exists in UE 5GMM context upon UAS services registration request.

entities.name: UUAA procedure
entities.description: Uncrewed Aerial System Authentication and Authorization procedure triggered for UE supporting UAS services.

entities.name: UE supports UAS services
entities.description: Condition where the UE supports Uncrewed Aerial System services.

entities.name: Valid successful UUAA result in UE 5GMM context
entities.description: Condition where a valid successful UUAA result exists in the UE 5GMM context upon registration for UAS services is requested.

entities.name: UE 5GMM context
entities.description: The 5G Mobility Management context stored for the UE, containing authentication and authorization results.

relations.description: The network includes the Service-level-AA container IE when UUAA procedure is triggered for UE supporting UAS services.
Inclusion of Service-level-AA container is guarded by the condition that UE supports UAS services.
Inclusion of Service-level-AA container may be guarded by the condition that a valid successful UUAA result exists in UE 5GMM context upon UAS services registration request.
The UE 5GMM context establishes the condition for valid successful UUAA result.
